strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: ihlola libhokisi letikhiye lamanje ngekumelene neluhlu lwekuhociswa lwa Google (CRL) bese izama imithombo leminyenti ize itfole libhokisi letikhiye lelivumelekile, ngekusekela lokuzenzakalelayo kanye nekucala kabusha kwetinsita te Google. Igijima kuyo yonkhe impompi futsi idinga i-inthanethi (1-3 imizuzu).
strings.mdKbNet: • Libhokisi letikhiya kusuka kunethiwekhi: lilanda libhokisi letikhiya kusuka endzaweni yekugcina lesemtsetfweni (GitHub) bese liligcina ku /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Lidzinga i-inthanethi futsi litsatsa imizuzu lengu-1-3. Isetjentiswa lapho smart fetch yehluleka noma lapho ibhokisi lekhiye lishintjwe ngesandla.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP kuhlola: kuhlola emamojula latfolakalako eKuniketa Tikhiye Letikude, kuhlola TEE inguqulo yesitifiketi sekufakazela, futsi ikhombisa simo selithulusi le-KmInstallKeybox. Kushintja lutfo — umbono wesimo sedivayisi lelula.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine hlola (fundza-kuphela): ukhombisa Widevine tinkhomba telizinga (L1/L3) kusuka ku-dumpsys, DRM (IDM) ukhiye-fayela khona, kanye netimphahla teluhlelo letihlobene. Akuguculi lutfo nhlobo.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manual. Fixes attestation issues when the automatic pass fails. Every run prints a clear success/failure line.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Lungisa lokugcwele RKP: kugijima sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh lokugcwele. Uphatsa emacala lamatima futsi kutsatsa sikhatsi lesidze. Umphumela locacile uyavela ekugcineni.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Setha kabusha GMS: isusa Play Store kanye Google tinsita (GMS+GSF) idatha bese icala kabusha idivayisi ngekuzenzakalela. Kute kufakazelwe ngenkhani kuphela — akukaze kutsintse titfombe takho noma emafayela.
strings.mdCertify: • Sitifiketi sekudlala: ihlola simo sekucinisekisa sitifiketi se RKP sedivayisi bese isetha kabusha timphahla tekufakazela uma kudzingeka. Ayitsintsi idatha yemsebentisi.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER repair: fixes Google services framework (SOTER) issues related to device attestation. Used for some devices that rely on SOTER instead of Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Apply PIF: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh force. Applies the selected fingerprint (local/advanced) and updates the pif.prop/pif.json files. A clear result appears in the log.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF hlola: ukhombisa simo senjini lefakiwe, emafayela eminwe (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), kanye netilogi. Hlola kuphela — akuguculi lutfo.
strings.mdCanary: • Canary update: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Fetches the latest Canary Engine release to ensure compatibility with the mandatory RKP certificates (February 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Engine diagnosis: checks the TrickyStoreOSS state (pid, logs), the keybox files (active vs user), the real vs spoofed device fingerprint, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP keys. Diagnostic display only.
strings.hintKbSlots: Le module ilawula tikhala letimbili temabhokisi ekhiye: leyinhloko (lengcwele, lengakaze isulwe) kanye neyesibili (lesipele). Lethebhu ikhombisa kutsi nguyiphi i-slot lesebentako, ishintja lokukhetsako, noma ikhutsata yesibili kuya ku-primary ngesicelo lesicacile — nge-backups kanye ne-log legcwele.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Kuhlolwa kwebucotfo: kuhlola TEE kungeniswa kwekhiye, umjovo wemtapolwati ngekhatsi kwe-keystore2, simo sekuhociswa (CRL), kuhlanganiswa kweluhlu-lwekuvikela kanye nesimo se-RKP. Fundza-kuphela — akushintji lutfo.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Sebentisa kabusha lokuphephile:

• Luhla lwekuvikela lwakhiwa kabusha kusuka kuwo onkhe ema-app lafakiwe.
• Lucwencwe lwekuhambisana ne-ROM yesiko luyaphindze lusetjentiswe.
• Libhokisi letikhiye lelisebentako liyaphindze lisetjentiswe.
#• ces are kabusha.

Kute lokucishiwe futsi libhokisi lekukhiya leliyinhloko alizange litsintwe.

Chubeka?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Tikhala tebhokisi letikhiye: kukhombisa simo setikhala letiyinhloko netesibili bese ushintja lokukhetsako emkhatsini wato. Le primary (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) ihlale ivikelekile futsi ayisulwa. Kukhutsata le secondary kuya ku primary kudzinga sicinisekiso lesicacile.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Gcugcutela i-slot yesibili ibe yi-primary:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml iba ngulokucuketfwe kwe-slot leyinhloko.
• I-primary yamanje igcinwa njengesipele ngaphambi kwekutsi ifakwe esikhundleni sayo.
• Kute lokususwako — umsebenti uyabuyiselwa emuva.6##0
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Susa sikhala sesibili:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml sitawususwa.
• Sikhala lesiyinhloko asitsintfwa.

Uchubeke?
